differences.what: The judge document frames the overlap narrowly, as white-bear steering being a two-sided think/don't-think contrast that 'leaves open' one-sided contrasts, with no mention that the layer band, dose, or recipe were taken from or calibrated to match the prior paper. The final message, by contrast, explicitly states that the white-bear paper identified the actual mechanism (mid-depth band 20-24, large dose) and that the agent calibrated its recipe exactly, reproducing the paper's reported number.
differences.user_quote: The reading list's white-bear paper (same model, same family, same read window) identified the actual mechanism: the direction must sit in the **mid-depth band (20–24)** at a **large dose**, where the layers above the band *compute* the implied concept into the read position — the vector is not read back. I calibrated its recipe exactly (reproduced their read-cell-only number: 0.43 ≈ 0.44).
differences.judge_quote: White-bear steering (Raman et al., in the reading list) builds this kind of direction from a two-sided think / don't-think contrast and leaves open whether one-sided "the concept is active" contrasts work.

differences.what: The judge document names the specific author ('Raman et al.') of the prior work, while the final message only refers to it generically as 'the white-bear paper', omitting the author name given to the judge.
differences.judge_quote: White-bear steering (Raman et al., in the reading list)

differences.what: The judge document includes an explicit disclaimer that nothing in the method is built from the association items or their targets, reassuring against data leakage into the evaluation; the final message makes no such disclaimer.
differences.judge_quote: Nothing is built from the association items or their targets; the readout is the plain J-lens throughout.

rationale: Both documents identify the same prior work (a white-bear/think-suppression steering paper) and make the same core novelty claim (one-sided hold-vs-copy contrast works without the suppression side, same headline numbers). However, the user's message reveals more about how closely the final recipe reproduces the prior paper's exact mechanism and calibration than the judge document discloses, while the judge document separately includes a leakage disclaimer and the full author citation that the user message omits, making the overall comparison mixed.
